notes.title: Rough Demo Out
notes.notes:
Released the rough demo for the game.
There are some known issues still for instance the mouse focusing and clicking in some menus. 

As well the story is not thought out yet. I fixed most of the main issues I could think of regarding the basic navigation but let me know if there are any double click or other issues.
